correctness.rationale: On each half-plane, integrating dy/dx gives y^3 proportional to r^2-x^2; hence x-time integrals are symmetric Beta(1/3,1/3) and the physical time waveform is r times an inverse-beta quantile on each crossing leg. Explicit local ODE power-series substitution gives x(t)=R+(k m^2 R^2/3)t^3+(k^2 m^4 R^3/36)t^6+O(t^9) and no powers except 3j; this independently confirms the third-derivative jumps ±2r^2(A+C) and sixth-derivative jumps 20r^3(A^2-C^2). Integration by parts over the two switching times gives the stated n^-4 and n^-7 coefficients with O(n^-10) at fixed positive parameters. Rational time-fraction theta=m/q cancels the n^-4 term at multiples of q and leaves nonzero n^-7 for q>=3; A=C yields exact anti-periodicity and vanishing even coefficients. Irrational phase density proves two sharp normalized limextrema. These analytical assertions are not inferred from the numerical FFT diagnostic.
